actual: The code intelligence adapter includes full raw CodeGraph status/version payloads with ANSI escape sequences inside doctor/full JSON outputs. This wastes tokens for Codex/Claude issue workflow diagnostics and makes compact workflow decisions harder to consume. Keep accurate metrics, but sanitize and summarize successful external tool payloads; preserve full diagnostics only for failures or explicit output files.
